questions.question: As long as King Uzziah of Judah sought the LORD, what did God give him?
When King Uzziah of Judah went into the temple of the LORD, what did he try to do?

answers.text: Burn incense on the altar himself
Pray for the priests serving there
Bring a gift of gold for the temple

questions.question: When King Uzziah of Judah raged at the priests in the temple, what broke out on his forehead?
When Azariah and eighty priests stood against King Uzziah of Judah in the temple, what did they tell him?

answers.text: He has no right to offer incense
He must bring a better offering
He must wait until the evening
